name: print-social-vinyl-record-album-cover-with-noose-and-hand
title: Sepia record sleeve with a hand and rope, half-slid from its cover to reveal a black vinyl
whatItIs: A black background with a sepia paper-textured record sleeve showing an outstretched hand and a hanging rope, with small typography, and a black vinyl disc with a grey label pulled half out.
whatItMeans: Stark and haunting; sepia and black feel like an old archival release.
techniques: Slide the record half out of the sleeve.
Set small type at the top.

vocabulary.definition: A record cover shown with the disc.
An object partly pulled out of its cover.
Fibrous surface texture on a cover.
